heading: Key Initiatives
intro: ACTS initiatives put science, education, and community action to work in Eastside Houston neighborhoods.

items.title: Air Quality + Data
items.body: ACTS maintains community air-monitoring networks in Pleasantville, Clinton Park, and Fidelity while engaging research experts to advance data literacy, address health disparities, and strengthen resilience.

link.label: Visit the Air Quality + Data Center

items.title: Family Resilience
items.body: Health screenings, food-security resources, and disaster preparedness support that help families stay healthy and ready.

items.title: Curriculum Garden
items.body: A 1.3-acre pollinator garden at Holland Middle School that serves as a pillar of the school curriculum, advancing science, health, and food literacy.

items.title: Cooler Play Spaces
items.body: A shade structure addressing the urban heat-island effect at a community playground.

panels.label: INTERVENTION
panels.body: Installation of a shade structure at a community playground.

items.title: Resilient Landscapes
items.body: Community beautification and strategic landscaping that reduce stormwater runoff and strengthen community resilience.

items.title: Youth STEAM + Robotics
items.body: Real-world learning that empowers the next generation of problem-solvers and leaders.
